Payment plans

Motion·by @praveenisomer·2026-08-27·inspora page·original post

What it is

Payment-plan card with a physical toggle metaphor: two little hanging tags (blue Monthly / orange Yearly) dangle above the card; flipping the plan swings the active tag, swings the card's neon edge-glow between blue and orange, rolls the price ($20.00 <-> $200.00), and swaps the feature list.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Dark card, Monthly active: blue glow rim + blue tag pulled down; '$20.00 Billed Monthly'; 4-item Includes list; 'Best For Those Who Want To Try It Out' ribbon below.
15-35%
Toggle: tags swing like pull-cords (pendulum rotate), glow crossfades blue->orange, price rolls odometer-style to $200.00, list crossfades to 6 items.
35-55%
Yearly settled: orange neon rim, 'Best For Long-Term Seeking Extra Benefits' ribbon; tag pendulum decays to rest.
55-85%
Flip back to Monthly: same swing + glow crossfade + price roll; ribbon text swaps.
85-100%
Loop; one frame reveals the component inside a Framer-like editor (it is a coded component).

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a payment-plan card with a physical toggle metaphor - two little hanging tags (blue Monthly / orange Yearly) dangle above the card; flipping the plan swings the active tag like a pull-cord, swings the card's neon edge-glow between blue and orange, rolls the price ($20.00 <-> $200.00) odometer-style, and swaps the feature list.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark card with a neon rim glow (blue when Monthly). Above the card: two hanging tags on short cords - blue Monthly, orange Yearly. Card content: "$20.00 Billed Monthly", 4-item Includes list, ribbon below reading "Best For Those Who Want To Try It Out". Yearly: orange rim, $200.00, 6 items, "Best For Long-Term Seeking Extra Benefits".

## Motion spec
Pattern: toggle with physics accent.
- Toggle tap: the newly active tag swings like a pull-cord - pendulum rotation ~900ms with damped decay (release angle ~12deg, spring stiffness ~120, damping ~8), settling to rest.
- Rim glow: crossfades blue <-> orange over 400ms (box-shadow + border color together).
- Price: rolls odometer-style digit by digit, 500ms ease-out.
- Feature list: crossfades 300ms (old list out slightly faster than new list in).
- Ribbon: text swaps with a short fade, 200ms.

## Calibration
- The pendulum decay is the character - under-damped enough for 2-3 visible swings, settling under 1s.
- Price roll 500ms; digits roll in the direction of change (up for yearly, down for monthly).
- Glow crossfade 400ms centered on the tag's first swing - light follows the tag.

## Reduced motion
Tags rotate to position without swinging (300ms ease-out); price swaps without rolling; glow crossfade stays.

## Don't miss
- Only the newly active tag swings; the other hangs still.
- The glow is a rim (border + tight shadow), not a full-card wash.
- List item counts differ per plan (4 vs 6) - the crossfade must handle height change smoothly.
